final: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate FROM matched) SELECT m.orderslink, m.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(m.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((m.rebrate - m.feerate) / NULLIF(m.feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(m.rebtotal) - b.avg_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM matched AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b GROUP BY m.orderslink, m.ordertune HAVING AVG(m.rebtotal) > b.avg_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10
